note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes User.ReadWrite.All, Group.ReadWrite.All, Directory.ReadWrite.All, User.Invite.All, Team.Create, TeamMember.ReadWrite.All, Team.ReadBasic.All, TeamMember.Read.All, Reports.Read.All, Policy.ReadWrite.ApplicationConfiguration -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
$alex = Get-LabUserId 'alex.demo'; $jordan = Get-LabUserId 'jordan.demo'; Set-LabVar MG_ALEX_ID $alex; Set-LabVar MG_JORDAN_ID $jordan
# security group Team Creators with Alex as member

$tc = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq 'Team Creators'").value | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $tc) { $tc = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/groups -Body @{ displayName = 'Team Creators'; mailEnabled = $false; mailNickname = 'team-creators'; securityEnabled = $true; 'members@odata.bind' = @("https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/$alex") } }; Set-LabVar MG_TEAMCREATORS_ID $tc.id
# throwaway owner temp.owner (random one-off sign-in secret, never stored) and one fictional guest invited without e-mail

$guest = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/invitations -Body @{ invitedUserEmailAddress = 'partner.demo@fabrikam.example'; invitedUserDisplayName = 'Partner Demo'; inviteRedirectUrl = 'https://myapps.microsoft.com'; sendInvitationMessage = $false }

$skus = (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/subscribedSkus).value; $e5 = $skus | Where-Object skuPartNumber -eq 'SPE_E5'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/users/$($tmp.id)/assignLicense" -Body @{ addLicenses = @(@{ skuId = $e5.skuId; disabledPlans = @() }); removeLicenses = @() } | Out-Null; Start-Sleep -Seconds 60

function New-LabTeam($name, $vis, $ownerIds) { $m = @(foreach ($o in $ownerIds) { @{ '@odata.type' = '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember'; roles = @('owner'); 'user@odata.bind' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('$o')" } }); Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri /v1.0/teams -Body @{ 'template@odata.bind' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/teamsTemplates('standard')"; displayName = $name; visibility = $vis; members = $m } | Out-Null }
# teams are seeded BEFORE the naming policy is applied

$g = { param($n) (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$n'").value[0].id }; $sp = & $g 'Sales Partner Portal'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "/v1.0/teams/$sp/members" -Body @{ '@odata.type' = '#microsoft.graph.aadUserConversationMember'; roles = @(); 'user@odata.bind' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users('$($guest.invitedUser.id)')" } | Out-Null
# deleting the owner is how Old Offsite 2024 becomes ownerless
# local copy of the policy with the Team Creators id (never committed)

screens.name: exempt
screens.account: labadmin (Global Administrator) + alex.demo in a second browser profile
steps: (Before the screen, off camera: the per-screen prepare applied the policy and waited 30 minutes for the group-creation restriction)
Entra admin center > Groups > Naming policy: show the prefix TEAM_[Department]_[GroupName] and the blocked words
Second profile, signed in as Alex Demo: Teams > Join or create a team > Create team > From scratch, name 'CEO office': show the blocked-word error
Back as labadmin: Entra admin center > Groups > All groups > New group, type Microsoft 365, name 'CEO office': it is created without prefix and without error
Delete the test group 'CEO office' afterwards
mask: Alex e-mail beyond the lab alias
prepare: Start-Sleep -Seconds 1800   # Microsoft: the creation restriction can take 30 minutes or more

teardown: foreach ($n in 'CEO office', 'Project Falcon', 'Sales Partner Portal', 'Old Offsite 2024', 'TEAM_Finance_Budget 2027', 'Team Creators') { foreach ($x in (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri "/v1.0/groups?`$filter=displayName eq '$n'").value) { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "/v1.0/groups/$($x.id)" } }   # skip the seeded teams here if episodes 3 and 15 still need them
needs: role:Groups Administrator + Teams Administrator + Global Administrator (labadmin)
wait:30min after applying the naming policy (screen exempt)
spare-licence:1 E5 seat while temp.owner exists
note_ep: If episodes 3 and 15 are recorded next, skip deleting the seeded teams in teardown.
